purpose: Choose edge, core, server, or no neural release from measured owned-data, architecture, training, global-gate, runtime, and hardware evidence. Parameter count is never release evidence.

profiles.name: edge
profiles.hardwareRequirement: Measured on the CPU development reference tier and must clear all release latency/resource gates.

profiles.name: core
profiles.hardwareRequirement: Requires a separately measured owned workstation/server tier and material quality value over edge.

profiles.name: server
profiles.hardwareRequirement: Requires an owned self-hosted reference tier and a proven material core ceiling before construction.

hypothesisRules.dataLimited: Supported when approved unique data is below the selected profile target and validation is still improving at the repeated-data ceiling.
hypothesisRules.optimizationLimited: Supported only after sufficient unique data, at least three controlled seeds, and a measured plateau or instability under an approved schedule sweep.
hypothesisRules.architectureLimited: Supported only when controlled architecture alternatives improve critical domain metrics materially beyond noise at fixed sufficient data and compute.
hypothesisRules.capacityLimited: Supported only after the smaller profile reaches data and optimization readiness and a larger profile clears every larger-profile gate.
